svg.title: Animal cell
svg.desc: Golgi body, Nucleolus, Nucleus, Cytoplasm, Vacuole, Mitochondrion

g.title: Golgi body
g.desc: The green organelle near the top of the cell.

g.title: Nucleolus
g.desc: The dark spot inside the nucleus.

g.title: Nucleus
g.desc: The large round body left of center.

g.title: Cytoplasm
g.desc: The pale area that fills the cell around the organelles.

g.title: Vacuole
g.desc: The blue organelle on the right side of the cell.

g.title: Mitochondrion
g.desc: The brown organelle near the lower left of the cell.
